title: pyspark on Windows - unexpected termination during collect()
question:
I am new to python and pyspark.

I'm trying to run it on Windows Server 2022. I have environment variables

  • HADOOP_HOME=C:\spark\hadoop
  • JAVA_HOME=C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-17.0.16.8-hotspot
  • SPARK_HOME=C:\spark\spark-4.0.1-bin-hadoop3
  • PYSPARK_PYTHON=C:\Program Files\Python312\python.exe

I have %JAVA_HOME%\bin;%HADOOP_HOME%\bin;%SPARK_HOME%\bin in my search PATH.

I have this source file:

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("UnitTest").master("local[*]").getOrCreate()
df = spark.createDataFrame(
            [["One"]],
            ["First"]
        )
df.collect()

Edit: I have seen suggestions to:

  • downgrade to python 3.11, which is now only receiving security patches and lacks a Windows installer.
  • try WSL or Docker, but that kind of defeats the purpose of having a quick turn-around in my Windows development environment Both of these options are work-arounds that don't really deal with the underlying problem.
